items.title: Hurricane Charity Scams Are Targeting Floridians — Here's How to Spot Them
items.summary: Hurricane season runs through November, and scammers know it. After every storm, fake charity websites, crowdfunding campaigns, and phone calls flood in — all pretending to help victims.

items.title: Rapid Fiber gigabit internet now available to all Suwannee Valley Electric Cooperative members in North Florida — check your address at rapidfiber.net
items.summary: The $93 million SVEC fiber rollout is complete. Go to rapidfiber.net, enter your address, and see if gigabit fiber (up to 1 Gbps symmetric) has reached your Lake City or Columbia County street. No contract required, installation is free for members.

items.title: Stop reusing passwords — Bitwarden is the free password manager that now supports passkeys at bitwarden.com
items.summary: Get Bitwarden free at bitwarden.com — it generates strong unique passwords for every site, fills them automatically, and now supports passkeys (passwordless login) for Google, Microsoft, Apple, and dozens of other sites. Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, Android. Open source, end-to-end encrypted.

items.title: Stop Windows spying on you free — O&O ShutUp10++ disables telemetry and tracking in one click at oo-software.com
items.summary: Download O&O ShutUp10++ free at oo-software.com/en/shutup10 (no install needed — just run the .exe). Click "Apply recommended settings" and it disables 200+ Windows telemetry, advertising ID, location tracking, Wi-Fi sense, Cortana data collection, and more. Works on Windows 10 and 11. Updated September 2026.

items.title: Stop fighting weird video formats — VLC Media Player is the free Swiss Army knife that plays literally everything at videolan.org
items.summary: Download VLC free at videolan.org — it plays DVDs, Blu-rays (with libdvdcss), weird camera formats (.MTS, .M2TS), corrupted downloads, network streams, and obscure codecs without any codec packs. No ads, no spyware, no "pro" upsell. Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS.

items.title: That 'Microsoft Support' Call Is a Scam — Hang Up Immediately
items.summary: Your phone rings. The caller says they are from Microsoft or Windows Support. They claim your computer has a virus, a security problem, or an expired license — and they need remote access to fix it. Sometimes they ask for a credit card or gift cards to "renew" your protection.

items.title: Two Critical Vulnerabilities Added to CISA Must-Patch List — Fortinet Firewalls and BeyondTrust Remote Support
items.summary: If your organization uses Fortinet firewalls or BeyondTrust Remote Support, apply the latest patches immediately at support.fortinet.com and beyondtrust.com/support — both fix flaws attackers are actively exploiting right now (CVE-2025-61624 and CVE-2026-102764).

items.title: Firefox 158 Adds Smart Window Form Filling and JPEG XL Support — Free Update at firefox.com
items.summary: Update Firefox at firefox.com or click Menu > Help > About Firefox — Smart Window now suggests form data from your open tabs and saved autofill, and JPEG XL images load faster with better quality than WebP.

items.title: Windows Sandbox Gives You a Free Disposable PC Inside Windows — Enable It at Windows Features
items.summary: Open Windows Features (type 'Windows Features' in Start), check Windows Sandbox, restart — you get a clean temporary desktop where anything you download, install, or break disappears when you close the window.

items.title: Rufus Makes a Bootable Windows USB in Minutes — Free at rufus.ie
items.summary: Download Rufus at rufus.ie, pick your Windows ISO and USB drive (8 GB minimum), click Start — a bootable Windows installer is ready in minutes, no command line required.

items.title: Firefox 157.0.1 Warns When Malware Reads Your Encrypted Traffic — Free at firefox.com
